verses.gurmukhi: ਭਲਾ ਸੁਭਾਉ ਮਜੀਠ ਦਾ ਸਹੈ ਅਵਟਣੁ ਰੰਗੁ ਚੜ੍ਹਾਏ।
verses.translit_en: bhalaa subhaau majeeTh dhaa sahai avaTan ra(n)g chaRhaae|

en.bdb: The nature of madder is gentle; it bears the heat but dyes others in fast colour.

verses.gurmukhi: ਗੰਨਾ ਕੋਲੂ ਪੀੜੀਐ ਟਟਰਿ ਪਇਆ ਮਿਠਾਸੁ ਵਧਾਏ।
verses.translit_en: ga(n)naa koloo peeReeaai TaTar piaa miThaas vadhaae|

en.bdb: Sugarcane is first crushed in crusher and then put on fire in a cauldron where it further increases its sweetness when baking soda is put into it.

verses.gurmukhi: ਤੁੰਮੇ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਸਿੰਜੀਐ ਕਉੜਤਣ ਦੀ ਬਾਣਿ ਨ ਜਾਏ।
verses.translit_en: tu(n)me a(n)mrit si(n)jeeaai kauRatan dhee baan na jaae|

en.bdb: Colocynth even if irrigated with nectar, does not shed its bitterness.

verses.gurmukhi: ਅਵਗੁਣ ਕੀਤੇ ਗੁਣ ਕਰੈ ਭਲਾ ਨ ਅਵਗੁਣ ਚਿਤਿ ਵਸਾਏ।
verses.translit_en: avagun keete gun karai bhalaa na avagun chit vasaae|

en.bdb: A noble person does not adopt demerits in his heart and does good to the evil doer.

verses.gurmukhi: ਗੁਣੁ ਕੀਤੇ ਅਉਗੁਣੁ ਕਰੈ ਬੁਰਾ ਨ ਮੰਨ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਪਾਏ।
verses.translit_en: gun keete aaugun karai buraa na ma(n)n a(n)dhar gun paae|

en.bdb: But the evil doer does not adopt virutues in his heart, and does evil to the benevolent.
